mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries removes the constraint that no two events on the same application may share the same (prevStatus, newStatus) pair. Injecting a duplicate transition forces a counterexample that both AppendOnly and FR_019_OneAuditPerTransition must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj e1, e2: AppEvent | e1.evApp = e2.evApp and e1.prevStatus = e2.prevStatus and e1.newStatus = e2.newStatus }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_DecisionByAssignedOfficer allows any loan-officer user to appear as decidedBy on a Decision regardless of the application's assignedOfficer. The injection creates a decision whose decidedBy differs from the application's assignedOfficer, which is exactly what FR-013 prohibits.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_WrongOfficerDecides { some d: Decision | some u: User | u.role = LoanOfficerRole and u != d.decApp.assignedOfficer and d.decidedBy = u }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_PermissionMatrix leaves the Allowed relation completely unconstrained. The injection places a compliance reviewer in the DecideApp cell, violating FR-004 and LeastPrivilege — exactly the cells the permission-matrix assertions are meant to guard.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ComplianceCanDecide { ComplianceReviewerRole -> DecideApp in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_OneInFlightPerCustomer removes the structural enforcement of the unique-partial-index on (customer_id) WHERE status IN ('Submitted','Under Review'). The injection forces two distinct applications for the same customer to both be in-flight simultaneously.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_TwoInFlight { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.appCustomer = a2.appCustomer and a1.status = Submitted and a2.status = UnderReview }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_DecidedAppsHaveDecision allows an application to reach Approved or Rejected status with no corresponding Decision row, violating the atomicity guarantee (FR-015) that status update and decision insert are inseparable.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DecidedNoDecision { some a: LoanApplication | a.status = Approved and (no d: Decision | d.decApp = a) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_ClaimEventExists allows an application to reach UnderReview, Approved, or Rejected with no Submitted→UnderReview audit entry. The injection creates an Approved application whose audit trail has only the initial submission event, breaking the count-based AuditCompleteness check and FR_011.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingClaimEvent { some a: LoanApplication | a.status = Approved and (no e: AppEvent | e.evApp = a and e.prevStatus = Submitted and e.newStatus = UnderReview) }
